title: 6.7.11 Fix the Broken Pseudocode: Dragging a Sprite
description: Repair half-finished pseudocode for dragging: give the mouse-up frame its own branch, put the velocity reset where it belongs, and stop a step jumping to itself.

steps.title: Repair the half-finished pseudocode
steps.instructions:
Here is what the finished feature should do, in plain English:

**1.** While the mouse is pressing: if the sprite is under the mouse, move the sprite to the mouse.

**2.** When the mouse is not pressing (it was let go): set the sprite velocity to zero, so it does not fly off.

**3.** Every path ends at the end of the frame. No step may send you back to itself.

The same plan is drawn as a flow chart above the editor. You do not draw it, you read it: follow the arrows and match each box to one of the steps.

Someone charted picking the sprite up carefully, and stopped. Their pseudocode is already in `README.md`. **Press Run before changing anything**: three checks should be red. Then repair it, do not start over:

- Give `IF mouse is pressing` an **ELSE**: the release path.
- Move `SET velocity TO zero` into that ELSE. It belongs on exactly the frames where the mouse is up.
- Remove the **GO TO**. Moving a sprite is one ordinary step per frame: the loop you are thinking of is `draw()` running again, outside this plan.

When it is green, trace this: the player presses the mouse somewhere empty, then drags across the sprite while still holding. Does your plan pick it up mid-drag? Should it?
hints: A sprite dragged around has picked up speed. If you let go without zeroing it, it flies off, so the velocity reset belongs on the release path.
Delete the GO TO line. The loop that repeats is draw() itself, not a line in this plan.

requirements.title: Pressing has an ELSE (the release path)
requirements.description: An ELSE branch for every frame where the mouse is not pressing.
requirements.hint: Give IF mouse is pressing an ELSE branch: the frames where the mouse is up.

requirements.title: The velocity reset is in the ELSE
requirements.description: SET velocity TO zero after the ELSE, so it runs only on release.
requirements.hint: Move SET velocity TO zero under the ELSE. A sprite still being dragged must not have its velocity zeroed.

requirements.title: No step jumps back to itself
requirements.description: No GO TO or loop back. Moving the sprite is one ordinary step.
requirements.hint: Delete the GO TO line. The sprite moves once per frame, then the frame goes on to the end.

requirements.title: Moving the sprite needs the sprite under the mouse
requirements.description: SET the sprite to the mouse inside IF sprite is under the mouse.
requirements.hint: Move the sprite to the mouse inside IF sprite is under the mouse.

planChart.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A([draw runs]) --> B{mouse pressing}
  B -- yes --> C{sprite under the mouse}
  C -- yes --> D[move sprite to the mouse]
  C -- no --> Z([end of frame])
  D --> Z
  B -- no --> E[set velocity to zero]
  E --> Z
planChart.caption: The finished drag. Releasing has its own branch, and the velocity reset sits on it.
